headline: EPS grows q/q, unchanged year-over-year
summary_short: Ciputra Development reported Q2 FY2026 EPS of Rp31.00, up 10.7% q/q and unchanged y/y.
summary_long: EPS of Rp31.00 rose 10.7% sequentially from Rp28.00 and was unchanged year-over-year versus Rp31.00. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
